facts.credit: Original SpaceFox informational schematic; no third-party artwork, lettering or logos redistributed.

features: Three solid core stages and four solid strap-ons; approximately 30 m total height with 4.2 m fairing and 2.65 m core/strap-on diameter as reported by Guangzhou Science and Technology Bureau.
Four boosters are spread in the schematic side projection to show their total count.
coverage.limitations: Original simplified illustration, not an engineering drawing or actual flight livery. The four strap-ons surround the core; a flat spread depicts the count, not the true front silhouette. Stage boundaries, proportions, fairing contour and colors are approximate.

geometryReference.basis: Guangzhou government dimensions and configuration; Beijing government September 2026 flight and ongoing programme.
